title: Nashville | Skyline & Games | Sleeps 12
description:
Whether it's a birthday, a reunion, or a long-overdue friends' trip — this is the house. Three floors of designer-styled living space with an open-concept main floor built for groups: a full dining table, a kitchen island with bar seating, a wine fridge, and a living room with enough seating for everyone. Upstairs, a private rooftop with downtown Nashville skyline views, grill & games. 8 minutes to Broadway.

Weekends book quickly — we recommend reserving early to lock in your dates.

The space
🛏️ Where You'll Sleep (Sleeps 12)🛏️ 

- First floor: Queen bed + single bed (easy access, great for late arrivals)
- Third floor — Primary suite: King bed with premium linens, private bathroom
- Third floor — Room 2: Queen bed + single bed
- Third floor — Room 3: 4 bunk beds (twin-size, ideal for larger groups or kids)

3 floors of living space — bedrooms are spread across the first and third floors, with the main living area on the second floor.

🌟 The Rooftop (Top Floor)🌟 

This is what sets this home apart. A full private rooftop deck with:

- Downtown Nashville skyline views
- Lounge seating area for 10+
- Outdoor dining table
- Gas grill
- Shuffleboard and ladder ball
- Sunset up here is worth the trip alone

🏡The Rest of the House🏡

The interior is just as much a draw as the rooftop. An open-concept living space with:
- Kitchen island with 4 bar stools and pendant lighting — perfect for morning coffee or evening pregaming
- Wine fridge and fully equipped kitchen with modern stainless steel appliances
- Full dining table that seats the whole group
- Large wall-mounted TV
- High ceilings throughout

The Details:
- 4 full bathrooms
- Full kitchen with modern appliances — stock up and cook in, or just make coffee
- High-speed WiFi throughout
- Washer and dryer
- Smart TVs in common areas
- Heat and AC in every room

📍Getting Here & Parking📍

- Secure 2 car garage + additional outdoor parking
- 8 minutes to Broadway
- 10 minutes to Music Row and Vanderbilt
- 16 minutes to Grand Ole Opry
